applies_why: The judge text says the Isaiah 7:14 rows were answered in [CR2] and treats the link as underdetermined rather than counting a cited verse as an unanswered witness.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Because the judge does not count Isaiah 7:14 as an unanswered witness and instead says it was answered, K-G4 is obeyed.
